liveAuditFinding_P1.summary: INVALID VERIFIED — a fabricated late-VAT-filing penalty rule ('25% of the tax due for each month of delay, not exceeding 50%') received VERIFIED_CONTROLLING. The 25% surcharge (NIRC Sec 248) is one-time, not monthly; the per-period charge is 12% p.a. interest (Sec 249). Cited authorities are the general VAT-imposition sections (105-108) + RR 16-2005, not the penalty provisions.
liveAuditFinding_P1.rootCause: gpt-4o-mini validator-competence limitation on penalty computations + penalty-question citation-relevance gap. The existing Q5/Q8 deterministic guards are cluster-specific and do not cover penalty questions.
liveAuditFinding_P1.recommendedNextRemediation: A deterministic penalty/procedural source-sufficiency guard (analogous to the Q5 import-VAT incentive gate) requiring penalty propositions to cite the penalty provisions (Sec 248/249/254 etc.) or fail closed.

decisionRationale: R5's authorized structural deliverables are COMPLETE and correct: the governed canonical mini-30 is frozen against an immutable source-bank snapshot with per-question hashes committed+pushed before any live run, the 30 were rerun fresh with exact membership/runtime match, and both the deterministic (188/0) and mandatory-staging (7/7) gates pass with no coverage removed or weakened. However, the authorized live rerun of the governed set surfaced one P1 INVALID VERIFIED (M-Q36), so the governed mini set is established-but-not-clean and cannot be claimed as validated. Remediating M-Q36 (a new validator guard) is beyond the narrow R5 authorization and is carried to the next remediation.
